experimental_method: Gas-extraction Bunsen-coefficient method of Ben-Naim and Baer as modified by Murray, Riley and Wilson (1969), with hydrogen saturated with water vapour at nominally 1 atm total pressure.
uncertainties_stated: rms deviation of individual points from the combined fit: 0.7 percent for this data set, 0.35 percent for Crozier and Yamamoto, 0.4 percent combined (stated as percent of mean beta); no per-point uncertainties
quality_remarks: Authors' results average about 0.5 percent higher than Crozier and Yamamoto (1974). Text says 36 points from this set were used in the fit after replicates were averaged. Table 2 (beta at integral T and S) is constructed from the fitted equation, not measured.
